title: What The Violin Knows — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The violin is the most human-sounding instrument there is
If you've heard it in a minor key you know the sound is his
Or hers — and what it sounds like is a voice that lost the words
And kept the feeling and the pitch and swapped the words for chords

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El violín es el instrumento que más suena como voz humana
[The violin is the instrument that most sounds like a human voice]
Si lo has escuchado en menor sabes que su canción nos llama
[If you've heard it in minor you know its song calls to us]
Suena como una voz que perdió las palabras pero guardó el sentir
[It sounds like a voice that lost the words but kept the feeling]
El violín sabe cosas del corazón que no podemos decir
[The violin knows things of the heart that we cannot say]

[Chorus — English]
What does the violin know that I don't know?
It knows the sound of grief before the grief knows where to go
What does the violin know in the wrong key?
It knows that sadness played with perfect technique sets you free
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le violon est l'instrument le plus humain qui soit
[The violin is the most human instrument there is]
Sa voix ressemble à une âme qui cherche son droit
[Its voice resembles a soul searching for its right]
Il pleure en mineur et chante en majeur sans effort
[It weeps in minor and sings in major without effort]
Le violon sait ce que le cœur ne peut pas ressort
[The violin knows what the heart cannot bring out]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the violin knows… Lo que sabe el violín… Ce que sait le violon
The feeling without words — El sentimiento sin palabras — Le sentiment sans mots
That's my boy
